title: Macromux: scalable postselection for high-threshold fault-tolerant quantum computation
summary: We introduce a new resource-efficient scheme for fault-tolerant quantum computation known as `macroscale multiplexing' (or simply `Macromux'), that utilizes scalable postselection to significantly improve the threshold of a given fault-tolerant protocol against both Pauli and erasure errors. Macromux is a hierarchical method for postselecting on constant-size space-time windows of a fault tolerant protocol, requiring only constant additional overheads.
